```js
function updatePlatforms(dt) {
  for (const pl of platforms) {
    if (!pl.motion) { pl.dx = 0; pl.dy = 0; continue; }
    pl.phase += pl.motion.speed * dt;
    const off = Math.sin(pl.phase) * pl.motion.range;
    const nx = pl.motion.axis === 'x' ? pl.baseX + off : pl.baseX;
    const ny = pl.motion.axis === 'y' ? pl.baseY + off : pl.baseY;
    pl.dx = nx - pl.x;
    pl.dy = ny - pl.y;
    pl.x = nx;
    pl.y = ny;
    for (const p of players) {
      if (p && !p.ko && p.onGround && p.platform === pl) {
        p.x += pl.dx;
        p.y += pl.dy;
        p.x = clamp(p.x, arena.left + 18*S, arena.right - 18*S);
      }
    }
  }
}
```

`solveAimAngle(p, opp, charge, weapon)`:
```js
function solveAimAngle(p, opp, charge, weapon) {
  const h = handPoint(p);
  const w = weapon || weaponOf(p);
  const speed = throwSpeedFor(w, charge);
  const g = ballGravityFor() * w.gravity;
  const dx = Math.abs(opp.x - h.x);
  const dy = (opp.y - 42 * S) - h.y; // target above feet, dy negative if above hand? Coordinates y down. 
  // Using formula for projectile launched toward +x with y up positive:
  // Let X = dx, Y = -(targetY - h.y) (positive up).
  const X = dx;
  const Y = -(dy);
  const v2 = speed * speed;
  const disc = v2 * v2 - g * (g * X * X + 2 * Y * v2);
  if (disc < 0) return 0.7;
  const root = Math.sqrt(disc);
  const t1 = Math.atan2(v2 - root, g * X);
  const t2 = Math.atan2(v2 + root, g * X);
  // choose lower angle that is >= 0.12
  const a1 = clamp(t1, 0.08, 1.3);
  const a2 = clamp(t2, 0.08, 1.3);
  return Math.min(a1, a2);
}
```

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Upgrade the BONK BALL canvas game with the user’s new feature batch: multi-touch, weapon selection and variety, no upgrades, buttons/sliders control choice, manual aim with vertical movement while held, no aim assist, crush-on-impact projectiles, moving platforms, new maps, and higher-quality characters.

## Requirements
- “More touches at once” — support many simultaneous touches/players.
- “weapon choose” and “different weapons” — selectable distinct weapons.
- “remove upgrades” — delete upgrade/shop progression.
- “choose between buttons and slider controls” — selectable control scheme.
- “aim moves up and down when held” — aim elevation changes while holding throw.
- “no aim assist” — remove auto-targeting.
- “ball crushes when it hit something” — projectile is destroyed on any impact.
- “platforms move” — moving platforms.
- “make different map” — new distinct arena/map.
- “quality characters” — improve character art.
- Build a complete playable game; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Screenshots for checks: small JPEGs, viewport ≤1280px wide; read only latest.

## Decisions
- Projectiles are single-use: any collision shatters/crushes them; bomb explodes; no bouncing.
- Added four weapons: DODGEBALL, FRISBEE, BOMB, BOWLING BALL, each with separate speed/gravity/damage/radius.
- Weapon selection is per-player on the title screen; choices persist in profile.
- Removed upgrades entirely; gold now only unlocks brawlers; old `shopper`/`maxed` achievements replaced by weapon-based ones.
- Added three map themes with distinct palettes/layouts/motion: SUNSET ROOFTOP, NEON HARBOR, JUNGLE TEMPLE.
- Added both BUTTONS and SLIDERS touch control styles; sliders use horizontal move slider + vertical aim slider + jump/throw buttons.
- Buttons mode uses automatic aim sweep while charging; sliders mode uses direct vertical aim control; AI uses ballistic solver.
- Touch input rewritten around pointer-ID maps to support simultaneous touches without one finger release clearing another.
- Character-art pass planned as part of this batch, not yet implemented.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed touch failure by scoping touch-pad CSS to `#touch`; committed as `e57aae8`.
- Added weapon data (`WEAPONS`, `WEAPON_BY_ID`) and map data (`MAPS`, `MAP_BY_ID`) in `game.js`.
- Removed `UPGRADES`, `UPGRADE_IDS`, `upgradeBonus`, upgrade profile fields, upgrade arcade tab/buy logic, and upgrade achievements.
- Added `controls` and `weapons` to profile with migration/validation.
- Added manual aim fields and weapon fields to players.
- Added `throwPlan`, `throwSpeedFor`, `solveAimAngle`, `weaponOf`, `handPoint` rewrite; removed `aimTarget`.
- Added `applyMapTheme`, `useMap`, `generatePlatforms` rewrite, `updatePlatforms`; map/platform motion wiring in `update()`.
- Added new projectile creation (`spawnProjectile`) and weapon-aware catch return.
- Rewrote projectile update to crush on players/platforms/walls/floor; added `crushProjectile`, `explodeBomb`, bomb AoE, shatter particles, weapon sounds.
- Added weapon achievements/triggers (bomb KO, bowling KO, long shot).
- Added multi-touch refcount handling, move/aim slider input, `setControlStyle`, `clearTouchInput`, touch-move integration.
- Added weapon picker rendering/binding, weapon labels, control-style segmented controls, and updated arcade to brawlers/trophies only.
- Added weapon/crush/boom SFX.

### Active
- In-progress: UI markup/CSS for weapon pickers, control toggles, slider pads, map labels, weapon HUD labels, and `rcMap`; these DOM elements are referenced by JS but not yet added to `index.html`/`style.css`.
- In-progress: character art quality pass.
- In-progress: projectile/weapon rendering in `game-draw.js`; old `drawBalls` still draws generic balls and `drawWeaponIcon`/`drawHeldWeapon` do not exist yet.
- In-progress: map-specific background/platform drawing.
- In-progress: aim preview rewrite for manual aim/no target reticle.
- In-progress: debug helpers/version update and testing.

### Blocked
- Game is currently likely broken until remaining referenced functions/DOM/CSS are added; no runtime test yet after these edits.

## Next Move
1. Update `index.html`: add `#p1Weapon`/`#p2Weapon`, `#rcMap`, `#mapTitle`, weapon pickers inside brawler cards, `#ctrlSeg`/`#pauseCtrlSeg`, slider-mode touch markup, remove UPGRADES tab, update how-to text.
2. Update `style.css`: brawler-card layout/weapon picker, weapon HUD labels, segmented controls, slider pad layout/thumb CSS, remove upgrade CSS, responsive rules, map label styling.
3. Update `game-draw.js`: add `drawWeaponIcon`, `drawHeldWeapon`, weapon-specific projectile rendering, manual aim trajectory, map-specific sky/city/fence/floor/platform visuals, and enhanced character art.
4. Fix remaining references/syntax and run `node --check` on all JS files.
5. Test on desktop and mobile: weapon selection, all four weapons, crush-on-impact, bombs, moving platforms, all three maps, buttons/sliders, multi-touch, aim sweep, no aim assist, pause/arcade/end flows.
6. Commit final changes and clean up test servers/browser sessions.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: data, weapons, maps, profile, layout, platform generation, physics helpers, SFX, DOM refs.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game-play.js`: input, multi-touch/sliders, player update, AI, match flow, HUD, debug API.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game-fx.js`: throwing, projectiles, crush/explosion, catches, pickups, hit handling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game-ui.js`: arcade, weapon picker, control toggles, UI binding, boot, render loop.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game-draw.js`: character/projectile/map drawing, portraits, aim preview.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: screens, touch markup, arcade tabs, HUD, how-to.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: layout, touch pads, overlays, responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/`: approved temp directory for test screenshots.

## Important Context
- Latest commit before current batch: `e57aae8 Fix touch: scope touch-pad CSS to #touch so body.touch keeps pointer events`.
- Current changes are uncommitted; working tree contains the large feature rewrite.
- Server for testing: `tmux new-session -d -s bonk 'python3 -m http.server 3002'` from repo root.
- `playwright-cli` Chromium is installed; use `--device "iPhone 15"` for mobile checks and force cache bypass when CSS changes.
- Previous touch failure root cause: `.touch` class collided with `body.touch`; fixed by scoping to `#touch`.
- Game uses no external assets; all art/audio generated in-browser.
- Profile persists in `localStorage` under `bonkball.profile.v1`; old `upgrades` fields are ignored.
- `window.__bonk` debug API exists in `game-ui.js`; extend with weapon/map/control helpers for testing.
